entries.upgrade_text: 消耗全部协同x，完成16+4x；允许x=0。耗尽。
entries.scene: Tang alone hands a finished complete exam booklet to the invigilator's tray, classmates absent from her working area; steady posture and a warm distant trail of learned methods, unambiguous independent submission.

entries.name: 约定进度
entries.base_text: 对单任务施加1虚弱，获得1协同，抽1。
entries.upgrade_text: 对单任务施加2虚弱，获得1协同，抽2。
entries.scene: Tang and two teammates set their progress tokens on the same agreed line of a shared board, three different hands and one common milestone; an explicit agreement on pace.

entries.name: 说明思路
entries.base_text: 可消耗1协同：完成6并获得3放松；实际消耗时同段额外完成4。
entries.upgrade_text: 可消耗1协同：完成9并获得5放松；实际消耗时同段额外完成5。
entries.scene: Tang explains a solution using a simple paper model in one hand and a relaxed open-palm gesture with the other, teammate listens closely; clear communicative thinking, no impossible finger directions.

entries.name: 一起复盘
entries.base_text: 抽2，主动弃1；本回合此前打过合作牌时获得1协同。
entries.upgrade_text: 抽3，主动弃1；本回合此前打过合作牌时获得1协同。
entries.scene: Tang and teammates revisit their completed model from above, three earlier decision points relight as they trace the process together; joint retrospective, project remains intact rather than under new construction.

entries.name: 保留意见
entries.base_text: 获得6放松，选择另一张手牌保留到下回合；无其他手牌仍获放松。
entries.upgrade_text: 获得9放松，选择另一张手牌保留到下回合；无其他手牌仍获放松。
entries.scene: Tang keeps a contrasting-color suggestion card visible at the side of the consensus board without discarding it, thoughtful expression and open discussion space; a preserved dissenting opinion.

entries.name: 各抒己见
entries.base_text: 对所选主目标施加1易伤，然后对所有任务各完成3。
entries.upgrade_text: 对所选主目标施加2易伤，然后对所有任务各完成5。
entries.scene: Four distinct adult teammates, including Tang, each bring a differently shaped idea slip to a round table, equal space and lively but natural expressions; multiple voices coexist before selection.

entries.name: 重排任务
entries.base_text: 回收1张本角色基础费用≥1的永久工作牌。耗尽。
entries.upgrade_text: 回收1张本角色基础费用≥1的永久工作牌。耗尽。
entries.scene: Overhead view of Tang swapping three differently colored task bundles between work lanes, correcting an overloaded side so the arrangement balances; hands rearrange physical tasks clearly.

entries.name: 及时沟通
entries.base_text: 移除自身至多1层焦虑，获得5放松。
entries.upgrade_text: 移除自身至多2层焦虑，获得7放松。
entries.scene: Tang and a teammate exchange a small urgent message slip across a short corridor at the right moment, both faces attentive, a quick coral-teal link closes their information gap.

entries.name: 相互体谅
entries.base_text: 恢复主角3精力，获得4放松。耗尽。
entries.upgrade_text: 恢复主角4精力，获得6放松。耗尽。
entries.scene: Tang takes over one manageable portion of a tired teammate's load while another offers a water cup; mutual consideration, realistic balance of books and hands, warm friendly expressions.

entries.name: 预留缓冲
entries.base_text: 获得9放松；协同为0时获得1协同。
entries.upgrade_text: 获得12放松；协同为0时获得1协同。
entries.scene: Close view of Tang deliberately leaving an empty buffer interval between two batches of task tokens on the schedule board, hourglass still has sand; unfilled space protected by her resting hand.

entries.name: 共同里程碑
entries.base_text: 消耗全部协同x，对所有任务各完成6+2x；允许x=0。耗尽。
entries.upgrade_text: 消耗全部协同x，对所有任务各完成9+2x；允许x=0。耗尽。
entries.scene: Tang and two teammates place the last complementary piece onto a shared campus project model, three contributions meet around one warm milestone light; pride in a common finished achievement.

entries.name: 解题发表
entries.base_text: 保留。须已开题；按发表前完成度C，对主目标完成C+10，对其他当前任务各完成floor(C/2)；C=100时各同段额外+20。结算后清空本篇记录，全部章节退回弃牌堆。自身正常弃牌；不参与论文记账。
entries.upgrade_text: 不可升级；效果同基础面。
entries.scene: Xu publicly presents her complete research manuscript on a campus seminar lectern, a coherent lavender solution structure unfolds above the finished bound pages; attentive adult audience softly behind, successful publication not merely writing.

entries.name: 旁听笔记
entries.base_text: 抽1。耗尽。同名副本共用论文牌名与每回合限次；战后移除。
entries.upgrade_text: 不可升级；效果同基础面。
entries.scene: Close side view of Xu attending another subject's lecture and capturing its key geometric insight in a small temporary notebook, two distinct subject colors meet at the page edge; listening notes, no full research submission.
